Chapter 7093: Below The Abyss

Chapter 7093: Below The Abyss

“Boom!” The platform descended into the abyss.

“What is he doing?” Immortals who stuck around didn’t know Li Qiye’s intent.

In their eyes, he had refined everything into worldly essences, leaving behind nothing of value. Alas, they didn’t have time to linger around and left.

Li Qiye’s descent wasn’t a regular one but rather, a leap into time and space. The enforcer’s slash created a new passage of the high heaven’s level.

It utilized the grand dao of the high heaven, erasing the immortals and overlords in this place. However, it couldn’t stop Li Qiye from reaching the end.

At the base was a concaved square - a perfect fit for Heaven Essence Platform.

Li Qiye looked around and saw a place with no affinities. Everything had been cut down while the walls were made from high heaven’s intent.

The intent smashed down and created the abyss. Upon closer inspection, there were complex runes that were naturally formed on the walls. Massive worlds hid behind these runes.

The bottom shared the same runes, seemingly containing the orders of the high heaven.

“What is the plan?” Li Qiye frowned.

“Crackle!” Weak currents coursed through the runes conspicuously. With more time, they grew stronger and revealed the worlds hidden within, seemingly representing the orders of the high heaven.

“Reshaping the will or to forge another calamity?” Li Qiye said.

“Crackle!” The current slowly crawled up Li Qiye’s body, seemingly alive. Suddenly, it became more violent and wrapped around him.

“Not a funny joke.” Li Qiye frowned and shook his body, sending the current flying.

It splashed again like water before coming together and forming a humanoid shape.

“Little swindler, take this!” It attacked before fully forming, releasing a will capable of creating everything.

Galaxies manifested into reality, beautiful like fireworks, and descended against Li Qiye with incredible speed like flying daggers.

Li Qiye smiled and blew out a single breath, shattering all of them. Even their destruction was magnificent and beyond imagination.

Suddenly, a hand grasped his throat, capable of crushing any immortal’s neck. It represented the laws and will of the high heaven.

“The high heaven’s will isn’t effective against me.” Li Qiye smiled and released his own will.
